references.text: Instructions concerning the burnt offering (עֹלָה) that Israel shall bring before the Lord; the same terminology is used in Lev 17:8
Refers to both Israelites and foreigners (גֵּר) who bring a burnt offering or a peace offering, parallel legislation regarding sacrifices
The foreigner (הַגֵּר) residing among the Israelites shall follow the same sacrificial regulations; the same principle of equality between Israelite and foreigner applies
Repeats the formulation concerning any man from the house of Israel or from the foreigners living among them, in the same context as Leviticus 17
The same chapter with identical wording regarding Israelites and foreigners (גֵּר אֲשֶׁר־יָגוּר) and their obligations
Fundamental principle that the foreigner residing among the Israelites shall be as a native; the same law applies to both groups
